(I)--a daughter of दक्ष, and a wife of Dharma, gave birth to मुद। (सन्तोष-वा। प्। and वि। प्।). भा.
(II)--a son of Vasudeva and मदिरा. Br. III. ७१. १७२. [page२-033+ २९]
